title: My tornado incremental is out on Steam.
author: YuriyBezgin
selftext:
Hey everyone! I shared [the 2D-to-3D experiment with The Big Suck](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1ww214m/) here last month. **The 2D game is now out on Steam.**

It's an active incremental where you steer a tornado through short runs, turn destruction into cash, and spend it on a bigger storm. You start by tearing up grass and grow until you can tear the planet apart.

For those who played the demo, the full game keeps going with fire, flood, ice and void storms, another planet, and even a little cow farm of your own. Around 4–6 hours of gameplay, or 15 hours if you want all achievements.

For the released game, Claude Code was used for coding. The music and four cutscenes were generated using Gen AI. I also used AI for translations.

[**The Big Suck on Steam**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4901860/The_Big_Suck/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_2026_11&utm_content=aigamedev)

Hope you enjoy it! Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
